At least 7 years of experience in Demand Planning, Supply Chain Planning or Forecasting within a manufacturing environment. Company: Lenntech Location: Delfgauw, Netherlands Duration: 6 to 12 months Company Description: Lenntech B.V is an international company located in the Netherlands that provides water treatment solutions around the world. The company of nearly 60 employees and 20 different nationalities is divided into several departments: processes for the sizing and sale of systems, R&D for research on innovative technologies, engineering for project execution, and a spare parts sales department (examples: membranes, filters, pumps, ...). Offer: As part of a multidisciplinary team, the intern will work with engineers, masters and doctorates alike and discover a wide range of technologies such as reverse osmosis, ion exchange and electrodialysis. The internship will be involved in the following tasks: - Lab research Performance tests on new membranes and for new applications, proofs of concept studies and optimization of operating conditions at lab scale. - Pilot scale testing Study of the system performance and data collection for further up-scaling: known issues, feasibility and operating conditions etc. - R&D support Bibliographical studies and support of on-going projects. Requirements: - In engineering school/university in master's degree (first or second year). - Fluent in English. - Interest in processes and the environment. - Flexible, autonomous, curious, team spirit and committed. - In possession of EU passport/working permit for the Netherlands. Job description Are you an ambitious Instrumentation Technician (E&I) from South Africa who is ready to build an international career in the Netherlands? Xelvin is looking for talented technicians who want to work in one of Europe's leading petrochemical environments. As an Instrumentation Technician, you will be responsible for maintaining, calibrating and troubleshooting instrumentation and electrical systems that are essential for safe and reliable plant operations. You will join a highly skilled maintenance team where safety, quality and continuous improvement are key priorities. This position is based in Geleen, one of the largest industrial and petrochemical hubs in the Netherlands. Your responsibilities Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on instrumentation and electrical systems. Calibrate pressure, temperature, flow and level transmitters. Troubleshoot electrical and instrumentation faults. Install and commission new field instrumentation. Read and interpret P&IDs, loop drawings and electrical schematics. Assist during plant shutdowns and turnarounds. Ensure all work complies with safety regulations and quality standards. Contribute to improving plant reliability and equipment performance. Employment conditions At Xelvin, we do much more than help you find a job. We help you build a future in the Netherlands. You can expect: A salary between €3,800 and €4,700 gross per month Full-time employment with long-term career opportunities Overtime and shift allowances where applicable 25 vacation days plus holiday allowance Pension scheme Extensive training and development opportunities Personal guidance throughout your career Complete relocation support Moving to another country is a big step. That's why Xelvin supports you throughout the entire relocation process. Our relocation package includes: Work visa and residence permit support Assistance with finding suitable accommodation Flight to the Netherlands Airport pick-up Municipal registration (BSN)Opening a Dutch bank account Health insurance guidance Dutch language lessons Ongoing support from your dedicated Xelvin Consultant Job requirements We are looking for motivated professionals who are ready to take the next step in their international career. You have: A recognised trade qualification in Electrical & Instrumentation (E&I), Instrumentation or Electrical Engineering. Experience as an Instrumentation Technician or E&I Technician. Experience within the Oil & Gas, Petrochemical or Chemical industry. Knowledge of process instrumentation, control valves and field devices. Experience reading P&IDs and electrical drawings. Good English communication skills. Afrikaans language skills (preferred). A proactive attitude and willingness to relocate to the Netherlands. Preferably between 23 and 28 years old, making this an excellent opportunity for early-career professionals looking to build an international career. About the organisation Xelvin has over 20 years of experience in connecting technical professionals with leading companies throughout the Netherlands. Every year we help engineers and technicians from South Africa relocate successfully to the Netherlands, where they build long-term careers with international employers. Xelvin provides comprehensive relocation assistance, from immigration support to housing and settling into Dutch life. Our client operates in one of Europe's largest petrochemical clusters and is committed to innovation, safety and sustainability. You will work with modern technologies in an international environment where technical expertise is highly valued.

Job Title: Junior BIM & Digital Twin Modeler (m/f/d) – Existing Building Digitization Reference ID: IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 Location: Karachi Hub, Pakistan (DHA Phase 1 / Phase 2) Contract Type: Full-time (Junior / Fresh Graduate / 1–2 Years Experience) Organization: IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit Application Channel: (Subject: Application IRIS-KHI-BIM-01 – [Your Name]) About the Organization The IRIS – Institut für Resilienz, Innovation und Nachhaltigkeit is an independent German research institute dedicated to advancing sustainable transformation, digital resilience, and automated building modeling. In close cooperation with academic institutions and industry partners in Germany, IRIS develops applied data models, digital building twins, and ESG evaluation frameworks. To scale our technical operations, we are establishing our engineering hub in Karachi. Role Overview In this role, you will be part of our core modeling desk responsible for transforming legacy building documentation from Germany into intelligent, standardized digital building twins. You will work closely with architectural and engineering specifications to establish accurate base models according to European engineering criteria. Key Responsibilities - Analyze and evaluate German historical building documentation, architectural archives, 2D CAD plans, and section drawings. - Generate precise parametric 3D Building Information Models (BIM) according to German DIN 277 standards (area and volume calculations). - Enrich digital models with structural properties, building envelope data, and technical building equipment (HVAC/TGA). - Export and validate standard IFC building models for downstream sustainability and energy modeling. - Maintain structured version control and documentation of processed building files. Requirements & Qualifications - Bachelor’s Degree in Architecture, Civil Engineering, Architectural Drafting, or a related technical discipline (NED University, DUET, or equivalent). - Proven practical experience with Autodesk Revit, ArchiCAD, or AutoCAD (academic project work or 1–2 years practical experience). - Strong technical understanding of floor plans, elevations, wall compositions, and construction details. - High level of precision, attention to structural numbers, and a structured working style. - Good proficiency in English (written and spoken); enthusiasm to learn basic technical German terminology is welcome. What We Offer & Career Pathways - Competitive Compensation: Attractive local salary package aligned with standard Karachi tech/engineering benchmarks. - Modern Work Environment: Modern, fully equipped, air-conditioned office in DHA with reliable power backup and dedicated workstations. - Long-Term In-Country Career Path: For professionals who wish to build their career locally, we offer stable advancement to Quality Lead, Senior Modeler, and Team Leader, alongside continuous professional training in European standards, modern BIM methodologies, and further academic qualification opportunities. - The International Research Track (§ 18d AufenthG): For high-performing team members who consistently demonstrate outstanding precision and reliability over 3 to 6 months, we provide the opportunity to qualify for a sponsored research transfer to Germany under § 18d AufenthG (Researcher Visa). This includes comprehensive support with visa processing, relocation logistics, and housing support / accommodation assistance in Germany. How to Apply: Send your CV by E-Mail: jobs-trainee@iris-institut.info
